San Francisco IFR Clearance Phraseology Practice 1A (SFOW)
Instructions: for each of the following flight plans, practice the full phraseology you would use when giving a voice clearance to the aircraft. Use abbreviated clearance phraseology. All of the routing is correct, nothing needs to be amended.


Flight Plan - UAL320


Callsign:


UAL320


	A/C Type:


A320/L


	Flight Rules:


IFR






Amend Plan




	Depart:


KSFO


	Arrive:


KSEA


	Alternate:


KPDX






Refresh Plan




	Cruise Alt:


32000


	Scratchpad:






	Squawk:


3342






Assign Squawk




	Route:


Plot




TRUKN2 DEDHD RBL LMT HAWKZ7








	Remarks:


/V/
